q: The quantum channel capacity Q (for transmitting quantum information reliably) satisfies:
opts: Q is determined by the coherent information I_c(ρ, N) = S(N(ρ)) − S(N ⊗ I(|ψ⟩⟨ψ|))
Q equals the classical capacity C
Q is always greater than the entanglement-assisted capacity
exp: Quantum channel capacity is given by the regularized coherent information: Q = lim (1/n) max_ρ I_c(ρ, N^⊗n). Unlike the classical case, a single-letter formula is not always achievable due to superadditivity.
